To publish it, you can use Power BI Report Builder (File > Save As > Power BI Service) or Power BI Desktop (Publish), then select the Finance workspace. Or, if you use a deployment pipeline or the Power BI REST API, that can upload the .rdl to the workspace.

I can still prepare the file for Finance. For example, I can point its data source at the Finance workspace's XMLA endpoint with `set_datasource_connection`, or run `validate_report` first to catch structural problems before you upload. Tell me which you'd like.
